entry_points.text: Private group returns none below L3 or without data, else ensures table init and returns shared group; L3 initializer declines low levels and virtual use, resolves node and geometry.
Frequency tick samples only with hardware support, publishes deltas under sequence and invokes scaler; query validates reference delta and age, else falls back to cpufreq or base frequency.
Hybrid enable allocates per-CPU entries seeded neutral, enables key and warns if already on; boot captures references on boot CPU, secondaries capture on each AP, resume recaptures.
Direct control stores per-CPU and writes register; conditional skips on match and defers under kernel IBRS; current-value read returns per-CPU stored value.
Bhyve detection needs hypervisor feature, locates base via signature and caches max leaf; feature query bounds-checks leaf, extended destination tests bit, x2APIC always true.
Boot parsers for MDS, RFDS, retbleed, TSA and peers validate text and bug presence, record disabled, full and threading requests, ignore unknown tokens with diagnostic.

exports.text: AMD L3 subcache sysfs pair reports current partitioning for the shared set in hexadecimal on read; write needs privilege, parses hexadecimal, applies via platform setter, returns count or error.
Per-CPU SRBDS and GDS synchronizers preserve unrelated microcode control bits and set or clear their disable bit from retained mode; GDS predicate reports microcode handling only in full states.
Guest virtual control compares host bypass expectation with masked guest input and requests a speculation update on mismatch; host expectation follows global disable or current thread flag.

Module check approves loads when branch protection is off or module is hardened, else taints and rejects; eBPF notifier warns on enable only under enhanced branch modes, one gated by active threading.

hazards.text: Frequency hazards are overflow, zero divisor, zero scale, stale idle samples and zeroed hypervisor registers; any anomaly warns and globally disables rather than applying.

Cache handling must tolerate missing data, absent features and allocation failure; subcache writes enforce privilege and parsing; SSB counting stays balanced; conditional writes respect IBRS deferral.
Unknown vulnerability identifiers warn; ignored GDS writes warn once; locked control blocks disable; forced GDS without microcode clears AVX; SMT disable during apply is irreversible.
Stuffing without retpoline, ITS without thunk support, debug-alignment conflict and fence-mode mismatch force disabled with warning; unprivileged eBPF under enhanced branch warns of leakage.

invariants.text: Private cache attributes hide without private northbridge data; partitioning shows only with partitioning support and index-disable pair only with index-disable support.

Frequency ratios and per-CPU scale start neutral with invariance keys disabled; scaler runs only when enabled, rejects overflow, zero divisor and zero result, clamps excess, else disables asynchronously.
One shared buffer-clear desire couples MDS, TAA, MMIO and RFDS selections; SMT is disabled only while applying active mitigation on explicit request or global on, with MSBDS-only exemption.
Active clearing requires matching microcode capability, else missing-microcode state; under hypervisor SRBDS and GDS select hypervisor-dependent and skip register programming.
Missing vulnerability marker forces disabled and skips work; parsers reject missing input, return-bleed splits on commas, unknown tokens warn without changing selection.
Speculation keeps global base, per-CPU current, arch-cap snapshot, mutex and return thunk; AMD bypass uses virtual register when present else load-store config combining base and mask.
Boot CPU feature and bug queries, capability forcing, SMT control, attack-vector policy and string compare are external dependencies used for gating, enforcement and option matching.

locks.text: Sample updates run inside write sequence section while queries retry until consistent; hybrid and scale state use single and per-CPU accessors to avoid tearing.
Speculation changes serialize on dedicated mutex with interrupts disabled; core SSB counting uses raw spinlock and per-CPU test-set bit prevents same-CPU reentry.

state_machines.text: L3 attribute table builds once: first call sizes from reported features, allocates, populates present entries and publishes; later calls reuse; allocation failure leaves unpublished.
Boot invariance enables on Intel under CPU read protection when ratio discovery succeeds; async disable turns key off and resets all CPUs to neutral; alternate builds do nothing.
Speculation update diffs thread flags from global base, routes virt, core and register methods and writes only on relevant change; Zen core counts first and last sibling under lock.
MDS, TAA, MMIO and RFDS resolve automatic via attack-vector policy into disabled or clearing, reconcile with shared desire and capability, surface status, then enforce capabilities and SMT.
SRBDS and GDS resolve automatic into disabled or full with hypervisor, missing-microcode, forced and locked refinements; L1D enables conditional flush only on explicit on with hardware support.
Retbleed, ITS, TSA and V1 gate on vulnerability and policy, validate build and vendor, refine against active branch and stuffing states, then program barriers, thunks, fences and threading.

structs.text: Per-CPU frequency sample holds sequence counter, timestamp, cached deltas and saved hardware counters; hybrid table holds one capacity plus frequency-ratio entry per possible CPU.
MDS, TAA, MMIO and RFDS each retain a small mode enum distinguishing disabled, automatic and active clearing plus missing-microcode or TSX-disabled outcomes where applicable.
SRBDS, GDS, L1D flush and Spectre V1 retain mode enums for disabled, automatic and full or on plus hypervisor-dependent, forced, locked-full and TSX-off outcomes.
Return-bleed, indirect-target, transient-scheduler, speculative-return and second-variant selectors enumerate disabled, automatic and technique-specific states with status tables for logging.
Microcode control uses one MCU option register with SRBDS and GDS disable bits and GDS lock indicator; capability bits report memory clear, fill-buffer, register-file and gather control.
Bhyve identity uses twelve-character signature with leaf offset one past base and bit zero for extended destination; max sample age spans tick rate over fifty.
